WoW: Forever

Combat Rogue

Sustained weapon damage with recurring burst windows, and the only Rogue cleave in the game. Two buttons while levelling, and the one Rogue spec Icy Veins and Wowhead both rate without reservation — ClassicWoW.gg does not score the specs.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Combat build has been tested — and none of our three sources publish a level-30 build yet either. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 — every tree now carries a new single-point milestone talent at 16 points, alongside the familiar ones at 11, 21 and 31; which row it sits in varies by tree. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Combat is for

RiposteRiposteTalentCastInstantCost10 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration6 sec lands at exactly level 20: 10 energy after a parry for 150% weapon damage and a 6-second disarm, on a 6-second cooldown. Every button the level-20 rotation uses is a trained ability rather than a talent, and Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. at 30 adds the cleave — 25 energy for +20% melee speed and one extra nearby target for 15 seconds, on a 2-minute cooldown.

Icy Veins and Wowhead both land on Combat; ClassicWoW.gg does not score the specs. Icy Veins rates it 4 out of 5 for levelling (3.0 Overall, tied with Assassination on both scores): "an incredibly simple class to play and to optimize damage. Your rotation will consist primarily of two buttons, Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMelee and EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMelee." And: "Combat is likely going to continue being an amazing spec for leveling and endgame PvE content." Wowhead agrees from the other direction — it calls Combat "probably the most 'complete' Rogue specialization at level 20," with all three of its main abilities already trained, versus Assassination and Subtlety each missing their signature kit.

Wowhead publishes two level 20 builds that differ by weapon, not by risk. Both take Improved Sinister StrikeImproved Sinister StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5., Improved EviscerateImproved EviscerateTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%. and PrecisionPrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 1%. as non-negotiable; the Sword Build flexes its last 3 points between Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant and MaliceMaliceTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%., the Dagger Build puts them in Puncturing WoundsPuncturing WoundsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point. instead. Icy Veins publishes the same Dagger-style allocation and states outright "we have made to ignore talents that offer us more defensive stats, specifically Dodge and Parry" — at this level bracket it judges them unnecessary. RiposteRiposteTalentCastInstantCost10 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration6 sec itself is real (see below) but no source among our three publishes a defensive "Riposte build" at level 20.

Rotation

At level 20 all three Rogue specs play the same. Icy Veins says so on its Assassination page, and Wowhead's own three level-20 guides confirm it by being largely interchangeable: "During the early stages of Rogue leveling, it is difficult to really differentiate the specializations."

  1. From 20, Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem on both weapons
  2. Open from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration-0.001 secAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. with AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee
  3. BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee if you are behind the target, otherwise Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMelee
  4. At 5 combo points, Slice and DiceSlice and DiceLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 sec if the target will survive its duration
  5. Otherwise EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMelee at 5 combo points

Multi-target: nothing until Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. is reachable. It costs 25 energy for +20% melee speed and one extra nearby target for 15 seconds, on a 2-minute cooldown. ClassicWoW.gg's framing: it is "two-target pressure, not damage across an unlimited pack," but "the attack-speed benefit applies even on a single enemy, so do not hold it through a whole boss fight just because no add is present."

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, critical strike, Strength, Stamina.

Published gear advice adds: slow main hand, fast off hand, and "Intellect and Spirit are wasted on a rogue."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • Poisons and Lockpicking are now secondary skills: "like First Aid", not Rogue class skills. Poison numbers are lower with more charges: Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem rank 1 is "13 to 17 instead of 19 to 25, 60 instead of 40" charges. Poison and a sharpening stone now stack.
  • Rogues can learn axes. Note that the skill starts at 1, so a new axe will miss constantly until you raise it.
  • Weapon ExpertiseWeapon ExpertiseTalentCastInstantReduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%. grants no weapon skill at all: it now reduces enemy dodge and parry by 1% per rank.
  • The tree "trades the dagger, fist and mace specializations for Flawless ExecutionFlawless ExecutionTalentCastInstantReduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10. and Puncturing WoundsPuncturing WoundsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.." Improved BackstabImproved BackstabTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd range was removed. Improved EviscerateImproved EviscerateTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%. moved in from Assassination; Improved GougeImproved GougeTalentCastInstant moved out to it.
  • PrecisionPrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 1%. is 3 ranks not 5 (3% hit maximum, was 5%). Dual Wield SpecializationDual Wield SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%. gives 5% per rank, not 10%. EnduranceEnduranceTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%. is now percentage-based at 30% per rank.
  • Baseline nerfs worth knowing: RuptureRuptureLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration6 sec rank 6 is "159 instead of 272"; EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMelee rank 6 was lowered. The base Expose ArmorExpose ArmorLevel 14 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration30 sec ability was buffed, rank 5 is "450 instead of 340" armor per combo point — the separate Improved Expose ArmorImproved Expose ArmorTalentCastInstant talent no longer adds to that value; it now cuts Energy cost and refunds combo points instead (see the Assassination guide, where the talent sits). Fixed October 1: a missed Expose Armor no longer costs you all your combo points (Blizzard) — the finisher is safe to throw at low hit chance.
  • Spell, melee and ranged hit are now one stat, as are all three critical strike chances.
  • New capstone-adjacent talent: Restless BladesRestless BladesTalentCastInstantYour damaging finishing moves reduce the remaining cooldown on your Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Evasion, Sprint, and Vanish abilities by 2 sec per combo point. cuts the cooldown of Adrenaline RushAdrenaline RushSpell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec., Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec., EvasionEvasionLevel 8 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secThe rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec., SprintSprintLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth. and VanishVanishLevel 22 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldown by 2 seconds per combo point spent (Icy Veins) — not reachable at 20.

At level 60

Unknown, and for Combat the open question is concrete: how Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantDuration-0.001 secIncreases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers and Fist Weapons by 5%.'s per-weapon-family effects and the new Weapon ExpertiseWeapon ExpertiseTalentCastInstantReduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%. interact with raid weapons. Item stats are hidden until they drop, so the weapon-choice question is not merely untested, it is currently unanswerable.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
